Title: Submit Patent Application
Scenario: Authorized applicant submits a complete application end-to-end
Expected Final State: Application status=Submitted; confirmation email sent; PCC_ADMIN notified

Title: Submit Patent Application
Scenario: Unauthorized user attempts to access the application form
Expected Final State: END-VALIDATION_FAILED; access blocked with authorization error

Title: Submit Patent Application
Scenario: Applicant withdraws the draft before submission
Expected Final State: END-DRAFT_WITHDRAWN; application deleted; no notifications sent

Title: Application Revision and Resubmission
Scenario: Applicant revises and resubmits within the 60-day window
Expected Final State: END-RESUBMITTED; application enters new review cycle; version history maintained

Title: Application Revision and Resubmission
Expected Final State: END-EXPIRED; status changed to Expired; applicant notified

Title: Application Revision and Resubmission
Scenario: Applicant withdraws application during the revision phase

Title: Budget Approval and Financial Tracking
Scenario: Budget within PCC_ADMIN threshold is approved and financial tracking initiated
Expected Final State: END-BUDGET_APPROVED; financial record updated; stakeholders notified

Title: Budget Approval and Financial Tracking
Scenario: Budget exceeds PCC_ADMIN authority; escalated to Director who denies it
Expected Final State: END-APPROVAL_DENIED; application on financial hold; PCC_ADMIN notified

Title: Director Assignment and Routing
Scenario: System auto-assigns application to best-matched Director and initiates review
Expected Final State: END-ASSIGNED; application status=Under Review; Director receives notification

Title: Director Assignment and Routing
Scenario: No Director is available; assignment fails and retry is scheduled
Expected Final State: END-ASSIGNMENT_FAILED; application remains Submitted; retry scheduled; PCC_ADMIN alerted

Title: Post-Grant Tracking and Maintenance
Scenario: PCC_ADMIN pays maintenance fee on time; patent renewed and next deadline scheduled
Expected Final State: END-FEE_PAID; patent status remains Granted; next deadline set

Title: Post-Grant Tracking and Maintenance
Scenario: Maintenance fee missed; patent enters lapse risk with grace period activated
Expected Final State: END-GRACE_PERIOD_ACTIVE; patent flagged for lapse risk; 30-day grace window active

Title: External Filing and Office Communication
Scenario: Attorney files application and receives confirmation; deadline tracking begins
Expected Final State: END-FILED; application status=Filed; filing date recorded; deadlines active

Title: External Filing and Office Communication
Scenario: Office Action received; attorney responds within deadline; action closed

Title: External Filing and Office Communication
Scenario: Filing rejected by patent office due to document error
Expected Final State: END-FILING_FAILED; error logged; attorney notified to correct and refile

Title: External Filing and Office Communication
Scenario: Attorney fails to respond to Office Action before deadline
Expected Final State: Application flagged at-risk; escalation sent to PCC_ADMIN and Director
